findings.message: Preserve the complete refused-task list when bounded feedback overflows.
findings.rationale: The 8192-byte truncation applies to the entire message, including the task-ID prefix. For example, forty valid 241-character t-prefixed numeric IDs already exceed that bound before any refusal detail. Later IDs disappear, so reviewers may need additional rejected submissions to discover every affected task. This contradicts the LLD's explicit overflow requirement that every refused ID survive. The three-short-ID test does not exercise this boundary. Provide complete actionable task identification within the feedback contract and add an overflow assertion.
